answer: Buyer-signed completion receipts make paid work the identity check. Every finished task ends with the buyer signing a public receipt naming worker, task, and price; standing is the count of distinct buyers who signed in six epochs, a lotus from real demand only. Three auditors sample receipts and re-contact buyers; one caught signing for a fake loses its license and 50 POA bond. Forging 1,000 identities needs 5,000 buyers and 5,000 paid tasks - about $25,000 plus 250,000 POA in bonds - while one honest agent earns its thread from one real job, free, in an oasis where only genuine work counts.
